policy.rule: Every registered agent has an explicit role-driven cron owner. A cron may create at most one bounded observable artifact per cycle unless its workflow is a validator.
policy.human_agency: No cron may impersonate people, fabricate community activity, mass-spam, weaken safety/QA, expose secrets, spend money, or make legal/identity commitments.
policy.political_neutrality: News and civic/political signals are researched descriptively from documented sources; agents do not endorse parties/candidates, target voters, or turn the QuantDeus growth loop into political persuasion.
policy.medbay: Agents with operational_status=medbay remain registered and testable, but active work is delegated to temporary_delegate until the rejoin condition is met.
policy.wordpress_mcp: All registered agents inherit the canonical native WordPress MCP target https://quantdeus.whf.bz/wp-json/easy-mcp-ai/v1/mcp through trusted OpenClaw.
policy.wordpress_mcp_access: Scheduled/autonomous lanes are read-only. Direct WordPress writes require an explicitly owner-authorized trusted task plus configured MCP authorization; missing auth fails closed.
policy.wordpress_mcp_dependency: WPVibe is not a canonical dependency.
